svg.aria-label: Skill tree. What I build. Fast by budget, not by luck: Core Web Vitals are a release gate, not a report written after launch.. Found by people and by AI: Technical SEO, structured data and answer-engine readiness, so the work is found and cited.. AI that stays grounded: Assistants that answer from the client's own data, with a person approving what matters.. Arabic-first, multilingual: Right-to-left layouts designed as layouts, not mirrored at the end. My portfolio runs in 17+ languages.. Secure by default: Every request re-checked on the server, every input treated as untrusted.. Motion, engineered: GSAP and Three.js, tuned so the animation never spends the performance budget.
